Is that Godot executable compiled with the latest version of your code? The XML changes in this PR look correct (and CI passes), you shouldn't have 24 files changed.

Not sure about the pre-commit failures.

Looks like this last commit ([6fc92cb](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99381/commits/6fc92cb150feba7521873400fc02b977f2aca4db)) fixed the issue thanks to an observation by @Meorge 
The method doc needed to be added alphabetically to the existing docs.
I also rebased the commit.
